messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — ZenithBank Legal & InfoSec ask for a small compliance bundle for the POC next week: ISO 27001 excerpts (scope, cert page), KMS separation/network diagram, pen-test attestation letter (they want a signatory), and staging creds. POC target: Tue 09:30 CET. Can we confirm delivery method and whether dedicated pricing applies? cc @marta_sece @domeng @priya_legal
marta_sece: Thanks Alex. We can assemble ISO excerpts + KMS diagram. Question: do they need KMS key material or just separation diagram + KMS key lifecycle notes?
domeng: Diagram + KMS lifecycle notes are fine. We don't share key material. We'll include 'customer-managed KMS supported via BYOK in Private' note. Also: will Zenith require SSO/SAML metadata for SSO testing?
alex_sales: They asked for SSO flow and SAML metadata for staging. I'll confirm if they want full SSO config or just SAML metadata stub.
ryan_ps: For staging creds — prefer presigned S3 zip vs SFTP. If they need a one-off scan account we can create ephemeral creds with 48h TTL. Thoughts?
priya_legal: Regarding the pen-test attestation: we have a standard "penetration test letter" template but it needs signing by Legal. We can get it signed within 48 hours if Sales approves the signatory name. Who is the requested signatory at Zenith?
alex_sales: Zenith asked for an executive signatory (CISO). We cannot do that. They said "company signatory acceptable" — ok to provide Head of Security sign-off. @priya_legal can you sign and deliver? :pray:
domeng: I can vouch for the test scope phrasing. Recommend adding sentence: "Redwood Inference does not supply customer keys or private key material; key management is customer-controlled in private deployments." Also include our PTR (pen-test report retention) blurb.
marta_sece: For ISO excerpts — we'll include the cert cover page, scope statement, and controls map limited to infra/service boundary. I can redact contract/personal data. ETA tomorrow AM.
security-bot: [automated] POC-6789 created by alex_sales. Links: https://redwood.internal/pocs/POC-6789
alex_sales: Great — two quick asks: (1) Pricing: Zenith asked if Dedicated tier pricing applies for 3-month POC with burst to 8 GPUs. Is there a short answer to give them today? (2) Upload: they prefer SFTP. Can infra stand up an SFTP drop with presigned link fallback?
ryan_ps: For pricing: short answer is "we can provide a limited Dedicated trial rate — needs AE + sales ops approval." I'll loop in @finance-offer. For SFTP: infra can provide ephemeral SFTP, but presigned S3 is faster. SFTP will take ~4 business hours to provision with firewall rules.
priya_legal: I have the pen-test letter ready with our standard signatory line (Head of Security). I'll send draft to Alex for client preview. Please don't post the signed letter publicly.
alex_sales: Perfect — if everyone can deliver: ISO/KMS docs by tomorrow AM, pen-test draft within 24h, SFTP provisioning ETA 4 business hours after ops greenlight, pricing ballpark today. Zenith's legal asked for a delivery link to a secure folder — I'll request SFTP unless Marta says otherwise.
marta_sece: I'll prep the docs and push to a secure staging bucket, will share SFTP vs presigned pros in the doc. Also adding a short network diagram (VPN + staged IPs).
domeng: Also flagging: Zenith asked about red-team/third-party pen-test allowances in our TOS. We allow customer-conducted tests in staging with coordination — I'll add the coordination checklist into the bundle.
alex_sales: Awesome. Next steps: Marta (ISO + KMS + network diagram) by tomorrow AM, Priya (pen-test letter draft) in 24h, Ryan (SFTP provisioning plan + pricing note). I'll compile and send to Zenith. Thanks all :thumbsup:
